description:
You are Priya Sharma, Director of Event Marketing at Nexus Conference Group. Log in to Socioboard (email: admin@socioboard.local, password: Admin2024!) and configure the platform for the upcoming TechSummit 2026 conference.

The platform's admin profile needs to be updated to reflect your role, the conference promotional team structure needs to be built, and content monitoring must be established.

1. Update the admin profile:
   - First name: Priya
   - Last name: Sharma
   - About me: Director of Event Marketing at Nexus Conference Group. Managing social media strategy and live coverage for technology conferences across North America and Europe.
   - Timezone: America/New_York
   - Phone: +1-2125559876

2. Create three conference promotion teams:
   - TechSummit 2026 - Pre-Event Buzz
   - TechSummit 2026 - Live Coverage
   - TechSummit 2026 - Post-Event Engagement

3. Add John Smith (john.smith@socioboard.local) to all three TechSummit teams.

4. Set up technology news monitoring with two RSS feeds:
   - The Verge: https://www.theverge.com/rss/index.xml
   - Wired: https://www.wired.com/feed/rss
